permanence: PERMANENT — this limitation must survive into every future dossier until pre-scrub evidence is independently recovered (which is impossible after filter-repo gc)

scope.description: Commits rewritten by the credential scrub operations (filter-repo passes 1, 2, and 3). All pre-scrub commit SHAs were rewritten and the original commits were garbage-collected by git filter-repo, making them unreachable.

scrub_operations.description: Removed CREDENTIALS_AND_MODELS.md from all history. Replaced 11 literal credential values (Lens, PatSnap x3, PatentBear x2, NVIDIA, Ollama, GitHub PAT, Scopus) and 6 regex pattern fallbacks with REDACTED markers.
Replaced 15 short partial credential references in worklog (e.g., MA5xazB4ECC... → REDACTED-LENS-PARTIAL...).
Scrubbed missed OpenRouter API key (sk-or-v1-...) discovered by credential_audit_split.py Pass B. The v25 scrub's regex sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{30,} did not match because OpenRouter keys contain hyphens.

scope.backup_branch_rewritten: backup/pre-scrub-20260818T225454Z was also rewritten by filter-repo and now points to a post-scrub commit — it is NOT a pre-scrub snapshot

affected_artifacts.description: All 10 ledger-anchored scientific artifacts had their commit SHAs rewritten. However, their CONTENT HASHES (SHA-256 of blob bytes) are UNCHANGED — the scrub only modified blobs containing credentials, not the scientific evidence artifacts.

infrastructure_blobs_corrupted_by_scrub.description: 5 infrastructure blobs (pre-v25-rebuild ledger files) had hash field corruption — the regex 15[a-f0-9]{20,} matched substrings of SHA-256 hashes inside commit_sha, previous_transition_hash, and state_hash fields. These corrupted blobs are NOT at HEAD — they exist only in historical commits. The current HEAD ledger is the rebuilt clean v26 version.

unavailable_comparison_evidence.description: Pre-scrub byte-level comparison is IMPOSSIBLE. The pre-scrub commits were garbage-collected by git filter-repo and no longer exist in the object store. There is no way to prove that the post-scrub evidence corpus is byte-for-byte equivalent to the original evidence corpus except for credential removal.
unavailable_comparison_evidence.reason: git filter-repo runs git gc after rewriting, which removes unreachable objects. The pre-scrub commits (e.g., 7b7644e, 5d62dbd) return 'fatal: Not a valid object name' when accessed via git cat-file.

substitute_verification_performed.description: Since pre-scrub byte-level comparison is impossible, three substitute verifications were performed:

verifications.name: POST_SCRUB_EVIDENCE_REVALIDATION
verifications.what_it_proves: Every ledger artifact resolves post-scrub: commit_sha → git commit exists → artifact path exists → blob_sha resolves → SHA256(blob bytes) == artifact_content_hash. Ledger root hash matches replay. Portfolio projection matches canonical.
verifications.what_it_does_NOT_prove: That the post-scrub artifact bytes are identical to the pre-scrub artifact bytes (except for credential removal).

verifications.name: HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT_DIFFERENCE_AUDIT
verifications.what_it_proves: No unauthorized REDACTED-* markers in any scientific artifact. No hash field corruption in any scientific artifact. All REDACTED markers in scientific artifacts match authorized replacement patterns.
verifications.what_it_does_NOT_prove: That the pre-scrub artifacts did not contain other modifications (we cannot compare to pre-scrub bytes).
verifications.result: POST_SCRUB_INTERNAL_CONSISTENCY_VERIFIED — 0 scientific artifacts with unauthorized markers or hash corruption. 5 infrastructure blobs with KNOWN hash corruption (pre-v25-rebuild, fixed, HEAD clean).

verifications.name: CREDENTIAL_AUDIT_SPLIT
verifications.what_it_proves: No credentials matching the configured detection corpus (8 format patterns + heuristic object audit) were found in reachable history.
verifications.what_it_does_NOT_prove: That no credentials exist in history at all (only that none matching the configured corpus were found). A credential in an unusual format could evade detection.
verifications.result: PASS — both Pass A (pattern scan) and Pass B (object audit) clean

what_is_proven: Post-scrub internal consistency (every ledger artifact resolves to its recorded blob and content hash)
No unauthorized modifications in scientific artifacts (all REDACTED markers are authorized)
No credentials matching the configured detection corpus in reachable history
Current HEAD ledger is clean (hash field corruption only in pre-v25-rebuild historical blobs)
what_is_NOT_proven: Pre-scrub → post-scrub byte-for-byte equivalence (except credential removal)
That the scrub did not inadvertently modify scientific artifact bytes (we can only verify post-scrub internal consistency, not pre/post equivalence)

dossier_language_constraint.required_acknowledgment: Every dossier that references evidence anchored to post-scrub commits MUST acknowledge: 'Evidence is verified against the post-scrub epistemic state. Pre-scrub byte-level equivalence is unproven due to filter-repo garbage collection of pre-scrub commits.'

authorization_semantics.research_authorized_means: AUTHORIZED_TO_RESUME_UNDER_POST_SCRUB_EPISTEMIC_STATE — research may proceed against the current post-scrub evidence corpus, with the understanding that pre-scrub byte-level equivalence is unproven.
authorization_semantics.research_authorized_does_NOT_mean: ALL_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_PRESERVED_EXACTLY — this stronger claim is FALSE and must never be made.
authorization_semantics.verdict_binding: The authorization binding (attestation_binding.py) explicitly records both the authorization and this limitation. The binding hash includes the limitation hash.
